name: Follow the supplier assurance process (ORR 17)
conditionsText:
- relevant if you have suppliers
- follow supplier assurance process
- depends on suppliers - needs to be people building thing on behalf of Dfe, have access to DfE systems and/or hosting
requirementDescription: To ensure suppliers that have access to DfE systems and data have appropriate security controls in place.
why: To ensure suppliers that have access to DfE systems and data have appropriate security controls in place.
